level.description: warn: will be summarised soon. full: summarised before the next answer.

summary.description: What the summarised part of the conversation said.

summarizedUntilMessageId.description: The last message the summary covers; the chat draws its dividing line after it.

canSummarize.description: False while there is too little to summarise.

text.example: Arbeitszimmer geprüft: lohnt sich nicht, weil kein eigener Raum.

text.description: The user’s own description of the household’s situation; empty while nothing was written (#501).

summary.example: Fahrten zu einer Fortbildungsstätte sind mit 0,30 € pro gefahrenem Kilometer absetzbar.

greeting.example: Hallo! Ich habe deine Akte 2025 durchgesehen. Wollen wir die offenen Punkte gemeinsam durchgehen?

conversationId.description: The conversation these messages belong to (#481).

conversations.description: Every conversation of this tax year, most recently used first.

projects.description: Every tax year with its conversations, newest year first; the list of the sidebar (#503).

context.description: How full the context of this conversation is (#481).

notes.description: The project notes of this tax year; every conversation reads them.

situation.description: The user’s own description of the situation; applies in every conversation of every year (#501).

message.example: Ich hatte dieses Jahr eine Fortbildung.
message.description: The user's message, at most 8000 characters; a longer one is refused with 400 and a German sentence under `fields[].message`.

skill.description: A skill the user switched on for this message (#495).

turbo.description: Turbo mode: the owl applies the drafts of this answer itself instead of waiting for a click. Off by default.

depth.description: Gründlich (the standard) or Max for this one message (ADR-0096).

quickAction.description: Quick start that shapes the turn: forgotten_check always opens with a visible plan (#451).

replaceFromMessageId.description: Regenerate or edit-and-resend (#451): the id of the latest user message. That turn is replaced; its pending proposals are dismissed, never applied.

conversationId.description: The conversation the question belongs to (#481). Without it: the one used last in this tax year.

mode.description: deterministic_fallback means no model answered; the UI labels the reply as Basis-Modus.

stopped.description: false when the run had already ended.

failure.description: Why it is not connected, or only degraded.

stage.description: What the app knows about the year: nothing, not enough for an analysis, or enough.

shouldOpen.description: True when a new conversation should open with the owl speaking first: something is entered and it changed since the last opening.

lastOpening.description: The last opening of this year, to link to when nothing changed.

messageId.description: Absent when only the title of the conversation matched.

snippet.description: The matching passage with some text around it.

reason.description: Only kept with a thumbs down.

acknowledgedCurrentValues.description: Re-baselines fields after a stale conflict: provenance key → the value the field holds now (from the 409 details). The write remains a compare-and-set.

granted.description: True while a consent to the current text stands.

version.description: Version of the consent text the app shows now.

receiptId.description: Der Beleg, aus dem der Wert stammt.

unconfirmed.description: Wie viele Werte dieser Anlage noch unbestätigt sind.

sozialversicherung.description: SV-Arbeitnehmeranteil (Summe Zeilen 23/23a/23b, 25, 26 und 27) in whole EUR. Absent or null when unreadable: the field stays open, or on a further certificate the recorded sum stands (ADR-0083).

receiptId.description: Optional receipt id for { kind: "beleg", receiptId } provenance.

overwriteExisting.description: Must be true to overwrite already captured LStB fields (ADR-0008).

addToExisting.description: Adds the values to a certificate already captured for the year (second employer, later payment) instead of replacing it. The same certificate twice is refused (409 LSTB_SAME_CERTIFICATE).

actionIds.description: Staged advisor actionIds fulfilled by this confirmation.

kind.description: `range` when either year is a range; `none` with a `reason`.

absolute.description: kind `exact`: the change in euros (percentage points for a quote).

percent.description: kind `exact`: the change in %; null for a quote or a previous value ≤ 0.

absoluteRange.description: kind `range`: low = current low − previous high, high = current high − previous low.

percentRange.description: kind `range`: the change in %, as a range.

reason.description: kind `none`: why there is no change to show.

value.description: tier `bescheid`: the exact value (euros, or % for a quote).

range.description: tier `schaetzung`: the range (from = to where one number).

source.description: Where the value comes from (tiers `bescheid` and `schaetzung`).

missing.description: tier `offen`: what is missing (machine ids, e.g. `bruttoarbeitslohn`, `personB.bruttoarbeitslohn`, `lohnsteuerbescheinigung`).

nettoQuote.description: Netto ÷ Brutto in %, one decimal; its delta is in percentage points.

exchangeRates.description: The CHF rates Swiss wages went in at (tooltip).

nettoQuote.description: Netto ÷ Brutto in %, one decimal; its delta is in percentage points.

exchangeRates.description: The CHF rates Swiss wages went in at (tooltip).

total.description: The sum: from the Bescheid, else as declared.

angesetzt.description: What counted: the sum, at least the Arbeitnehmer-Pauschbetrag.

parts.description: The stack; null where only the sum is known (an Eckjahr: „laut Bescheid, ohne Aufteilung“).

pauschbetrag.description: The year’s Arbeitnehmer-Pauschbetrag times the persons shown (the line in the chart).

belowLumpSum.description: The sum stayed below the Pauschbetrag, so the Pauschbetrag counted.

amount.description: Positive = Erstattung, negative = Nachzahlung; household only.

declared.description: The refund of the version filed in the app (the mark at the bar).

estimateBeforeAssessment.description: The last estimate before the Bescheid (detail only, not in the chart).

marginal.description: Grenzsteuersatz in whole % (splitting); null for single returns.

filingTypeChanged.description: The Veranlagungsart changed from the year before (mark it in the chart).

eckjahr.description: Known only from an uploaded Bescheid (`extern-erledigt`).

tier.description: The year’s tier: `bescheid` once every filing has one, `schaetzung` when the core can estimate, else `offen`.

netto.description: Brutto → Netto per „beide“, A and B.

answer.description: The answer; null while not asked.

askAgainFrom.description: After „weiss-nicht“: from this day the question comes again (three months before the deadline).

kind.description: `abgabe-moeglich-bis` without a Bescheid („bis 31.12.2026 möglich“), `aenderbar-bis` with one.

endsOn.description: The Festsetzungsfrist without a delayed start (§ 169 Abs. 2 Nr. 2 AO, § 108 Abs. 3 AO): true for every return.

remainingDays.description: Days from today; negative once it passed.

endsOnIfMandatory.description: The later end should the return have been mandatory (§ 170 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 AO); null when unknown or the same. Never shown instead of `endsOn`.

status.description: The stored ADR-0039 state; null for a year without a tax year row.

kind.description: How the year stands, derived from its data.

noDiffReason.description: Why there is no Abgleich (a sentence says why); null when there is one.

withinAssessmentPeriod.description: Within the four years of the Festsetzungsfrist; older years are for display only.

hasData.description: The year has facts of its own; a year of the Festsetzungsfrist without any is listed anyway and shows no amount (ADR-0099 §1).

filedElsewhere.description: „Schon abgegeben?“ for a year without data within the Festsetzungsfrist; null for every other year.

withoutAssessment.description: Filed elsewhere (or known from outside) but no Bescheid uploaded yet: „noch ohne Bescheid“.

deadline.description: „bis … möglich“ without a Bescheid, „änderbar bis …“ with one.

remainingDays.description: Days from today; negative once it passed.

highlighted.description: Shown first and highlighted (a Bescheid with deviations and a running Einspruchsfrist).

refundDifference.description: kind `einspruchsfrist`: assessed − declared refund in euros.

deviations.description: kind `einspruchsfrist`: the number of own deviations.

repeatedCuts.description: kind `wartet-auf-bescheid`: positions cut the year before and declared the same way again; no amount.

filingDeadline.description: kind `offen`, a year before the current one: the last day for a voluntary return (ADR-0099 §1).

askFiledElsewhere.description: kind `offen`: the year has no data yet and asks „Schon abgegeben?“.

source.description: `filed`: the next year’s frozen version; `answers`: today’s answers, not yet filed.

declared.description: What the next year declares for the position; never an amount for its pending Bescheid.

declaredAboveRecognised.description: It again declares more than this Bescheid recognised; null when it declares nothing.

screen.description: The mask (`Screen`) the lesson shows at in the next open year.

position.description: A position id of the core catalogue `ASSESSMENT_POSITIONS` (e.g. `homeofficeA`, `zuVersteuerndesEinkommen`).

hint.description: From the fixed catalogue per position type; null without an entry.

person.description: Whose single return; null for the joint one.

year.description: The open year whose masks show the lessons.

person.description: Whose event; null for the household’s.

employers.description: kind `neuer-arbeitgeber`: the employers new this year.

date.description: kinds `kind`, `immobilienkauf`: the first date of the year.

count.description: kinds `kind`, `immobilienkauf`: how many in the year.

screen.description: The mask the item is entered in.

lastYear.description: The latest of the last two years that had the item.

lastAmount.description: That year’s amount, as a hint.

lastDetail.description: Kilometres and days of a way to work, days of Homeoffice.

currentAmount.description: What the open year itself has entered; null while nothing (never last year’s value).

receipt.description: What the open year’s receipts did for the item (ADR-0097).

cutInYears.description: Years whose Bescheid cut the position again and again (ADR-0099 §5).

refund.description: Abschlusszahlung laut Bescheid: positive = Erstattung, negative = Nachzahlung.

backPayment.description: The Nachzahlung as a positive amount.

prepayments.description: The prepayments the year’s answers name.

consecutiveBackPayments.description: Nachzahlungen in a row up to the latest Bescheid.

hint.description: The catalogue hint for the position type.

filedAs.description: status `gerechnet`: how the year was filed.

approximate.description: status `gerechnet`: true for a joint Bescheid split by the filed facts („Rechnung der App, etwa“).

singleTax.description: status `gerechnet`: ESt + Soli (+ KiSt) of two single returns.

jointSaving.description: status `gerechnet`: singleTax − jointTax; > 0 the joint return is (or would have been) cheaper.

jointSavingRange.description: status `gerechnet`: the saving over the ways to split a joint Bescheid; null when it is one number.

rateChangePercent.description: Change of the rate to the year before in %.

creditedEur.description: Credited in Germany (N-Gre Zeile 25): at most 4,5 % of the gross wage.

creditCapped.description: More was withheld than can be credited.

swissShare.description: The Swiss wage’s share of the household’s gross wage.

result.description: Mieten + Umlagen − Werbungskosten − Schuldzinsen − AfA; null while a part is missing.

bookValueEnd.description: Remaining book value at year end; null without the purchase date.

undatedCounted.description: Number of repairs without a date counted in the window to be safe (a count, not an amount).

delta.description: Personal rate minus flat rate tax; > 0 the flat rate is cheaper.

favourableCheck.description: The Günstigerprüfung on the Bescheid’s zvE; null without one.

allowance.description: Rentenfreibetrag, fixed from the first full year.

pending.description: No Bescheid yet: counted up to today.

askTaxOffice.description: „Nachfragen lohnt sich“: more than twelve weeks without a Bescheid.

wait.description: Submission → Bescheid; null without a submission in the app.

today.description: The day remaining days are counted from.

years.description: The four key figures per year, oldest first.

openItems.description: „Was ansteht“, highlighted first, then the newest year first.

diffs.description: Every Abgleich of a year with a Bescheid and a version filed in the app.

maskLessons.description: The lessons for the masks of the latest open year.

events.description: Lebensereignisse, derived from data only (ADR-0099 §4), oldest first.

recurring.description: „Kommt jedes Jahr wieder“ for the latest open year (ADR-0099 §2); null without one.

prepayments.description: Nachzahlungen laut Bescheid over the years (ADR-0099 §3).

repeatedCuts.description: Positions cut in at least two Bescheid years (ADR-0099 §5).

couples.description: Per Bescheid year of a couple, the Veranlagungsart in both directions (ADR-0099 §6).

groups.description: Grenzgänger, Vermieter, Kapital, Rentner (ADR-0099 §7); each null without data.

documents.description: Unterlagen (ADR-0099 §9): Bescheide, duration and Einsprüche per year.

answer.description: `ja`: filed elsewhere, the year waits for its Bescheid upload; `nein`: an open year; `weiss-nicht`: ask again three months before the deadline.

status.description: The ADR-0039 state the answer put the year in.

confirm.description: Explicit confirmation — must be exactly `true`. The mandatory pre-delete export offer and Löschschutz warning are a frontend/UX concern; this is the server-side confirmation gate.

password.description: Required only when the caller’s current session is not fresh enough (ADR-0013 §6) — re-verified via better-auth’s own password check, never a second hand-rolled one.

profile.description: False only when an active LegalHold on "profile" exempted the row — it still exists, retained under legal obligation.

account.description: Always true — the account (User, cascading Session/Account) and its Verification rows are always torn down; LegalHold never exempts login/identity itself.

retainedAnonymisedAuditRows.description: Count of TaxDataAccessLog rows anonymised (userId severed to an irreversible tombstone) by this call — retained as the Art. 30 accountability record, no longer person-linkable.

retainedUnderLegalHold.description: Count of rows retained untouched — neither erased nor anonymised — because an active LegalHold exempted them.

taxData.description: Every stored tax-data row, decrypted (Art. 15/20); empty when the caller has none.

query.description: Street, optionally followed by house number and place or postal code.

postalCode.description: Postal code the form already holds; its streets are listed first.

available.description: False when this deployment has no street data installed; `hits` is then always empty.

houseNumber.description: House number found in the query, for the form to take over.

userCode.description: The short code shown on the desktop and matched on the phone.

deviceCode.description: The RFC 8628 device_code — held by the desktop only, to poll POST /v1/device/token. Not a session credential; carries no authenticated power on its own.

verificationUriComplete.description: The full verification URL to encode as the QR code (includes the user_code as a query param).

expiresIn.description: Seconds until this code expires (ADR-0024: 2 minutes).

userAgent.description: The requesting desktop's raw User-Agent, or null if it was absent.

region.description: Country code from task 0b's geo-IP resolver, or "unknown" — never null once task 0/0b's write path has run.

requestedAt.description: When the desktop requested this code.

zveA.description: The primary zvE-basis (Einnahmen from @steuereule/core — layer 3 open, no real zvE yet).

zveB.description: The partner zvE-basis (query param — M1 does not yet collect it).

components.description: Which tax components are folded into both amounts.

single.description: Full assessed tax, single filing (only when kind !== "nicht-anwendbar").

joint.description: Full assessed tax, joint filing (only when kind !== "nicht-anwendbar").

provenance.description: Origin metadata on both numbers (only when kind !== "nicht-anwendbar").

reason.description: Why the comparison does not apply (only when kind === "nicht-anwendbar").

minimumRateEur.description: § 152 Abs. 2 Satz 2 AO — der Mindestzuschlag je angefangenem Monat, in Euro.

percentPerMonth.description: § 152 Abs. 2 Satz 1 AO — 0,25 % der festgesetzten Steuer je angefangenem Monat.

filingDeadline.description: Die Abgabefrist (§ 149 Abs. 2 AO), ISO yyyy-mm-dd.

today.description: Der Server-Stichtag in Europe/Berlin, ISO yyyy-mm-dd.

level.description: keine | warnung (ab 60 Tage vor der Frist) | abgelaufen.

remainingDays.description: Whole days from heute (exclusive) to the frist; negative = abgelaufen.

lastYear.description: Das Quelljahr der Kopie — der Jahresbezug der Herkunft (ADR-022).

confirmed.description: false = UNBESTÄTIGT (kopiert, Anlage noch nicht bestätigt), true = bestätigt (ADR-021).

childId.description: The year’s Kind row when the person is part of the year.

fromYear.description: Last earlier year the person was part of („aus 2025“).

preselected.description: Preselected for this year (last year’s people, children up to 25).

asksForEducation.description: From 18 the mask asks about education.

updatedBySelf.description: The last change was made by the requesting account.

same.description: true = the same person (merge), false = two people
